[Verification notes · 30 October 2026]{.kicker}

Checked against `Exios66/aeroglobe` `935bd07` on 30 October 2026.

## Counts

305 `it(` calls in 43 test files. 6,211 lines of TypeScript outside test files (`wc -l`). The 23 October case-study stamp said 395 passing tests in 42 files and about 5,800 lines.
